title: The Summary export has no Sales Type column and rep rows leave it blank
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; it was invoiced today with a labor line and a part; Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Parts {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Export the Summary CSV and look at its columns.
  2. Export the Expanded CSV and read the Sales Type cell on {Sales-rep-A}'s representative row and on the totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Summary export has no Sales Type column.
  • Step 2: the Sales Type cell is blank on the representative row and on the totals row; only invoice rows carry Labor, Parts, Part Sales or "Labor, Parts".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S5-R23, read 19 Oct 2026. Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, uploaded 19 Oct 2026), Tech plan, export column, Tech plan, Expanded export values, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 4 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R23: “The Expanded CSV and the Expanded PDF always carry the Sales Type column, after Status, whatever the screen shows. In them, the cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank in the CSV and show a dash in the PDF.”
  • Tech plan, export column: “in `expanded()` only, never in `summary()`.”
  • Tech plan, Expanded export values: “"Labor" / "Parts" / "Part Sales" / "Labor, Parts" (blank on rep and total rows).”
